Commentary.Commentary: Right then. That is all we have from this clash. There is one more ODI left in the series and it will be played on 11th February. The match begins at 1:30 pm IST (8 am GMT) but do join us for the buildup in advance. Cheers for now!

Prasidh Krishna is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for his spell of 9-3-12-4. He says that he is happy that he could take wickets and win the game for the team. Adds that he knew what he needed to do and his plans were set. Says that he is happy to contribute to the team's success. Mentions that he did not want to try too many different things and wanted to keep things simple. Informs that he is working on being as consistent as possible and bowl in the right channels.

Rohit Sharma, the skipper of India, says that winning the series is a good feeling. Adds that the partnership between KL Rahul and Suryakumar Yadav showed good maturity and eventually they reached a good total. Tells all the bowlers came and bowled as a unit. Admits that it is important for these players to get in this type of situation and show character. Tells that the innings from Deepak Hooda as well was good to see. Adds that he was asked to do different things and they decided to get Rishabh Pant up the order. Informs that they will get Shikhar Dhawan back in the next game. Tells that they will talk about the changes and will see if they can give game time to some of the other players. Admits that he was surprised there was no dew but congratulates Prasidh Krishna for how he bowled. Adds it was a good bowling effort, especially from Krishna. He wanted some pace in the back end as there are many big hitters in West Indies.

Nicholas Pooran, the skipper of West Indies, says that they lost the game with the bat as they did not get any big partnerships. Adds that the more they play together, they will hopefully get better. He praises Odean Smith for his all-round show and says that with more experience, he will get better. Mentions that they want to do better with the bat in the final game and says that Kieron Pollard should be fine for the last match.

First, a word with Shardul Thakur. The pacer says that if dew comes in then a partnership can build and the batters can take the game away. Adds that the pacers were bowling really well as there was assistance in the pitch. Adds that if they take wickets up front then the game gets away from the team that is chasing. Tells that they used short balls really well and it was in the plan and strategy to bowl like that.
Stay tuned for the interviews.

A good game for India in the field as all the bowlers did well. Washington Sundar was a bit expensive at the start but finished well by getting the big wicket of Odean Smith. The captaincy from Rohit Sharma was also quite good as he rotated the bowlers well. They kept giving him wickets at the right point and India were never really in big trouble. Rohit Sharma must be commended for the way he marshaled his troops and handled his bowling resources. Prasidh Krishna was the pick of the bowlers with his 4 wickets while the rest of the bowlers had a good game too.

Shamarh Brooks did put on a 41-run stand with Akeal Hosein but when it was broken, the game looked done. But the stand between Fabian Allen and Akeal Hosein gave West Indies hope. The pair added 42 runs and there were few nerves in the Indian camp when they were batting. Right then Mohammed Siraj took his first wicket to break the stand and Shardul Thakur got a wicket in the next over to send back both the set batters. Odean Smith then got a few boundaries and kept the chase alive but he never really looked very threatening and India had enough quality in their ranks to seal the game.

West Indies needed a good start if they were to chase this down. The opening stand between Brandon King and Shai Hope looked good for a while before they were separated in the 8th over. After that, the middle order of West Indies put on another sorry show. It was only Shamarh Brooks who looked in good touch in the middle. The Indian bowlers were breathing fire with Prasidh Krishna struck thrice to rock the middle order of the West Indies.

A victory for India and they have sealed the 3-match series! They did not have the biggest of totals but bowled really well to defend it. A sweet victory but it will be a tough loss for West Indies. They had done really well with the ball but could not back it up with the bat.

OUT! LBW! Prasidh Krishna gets the last wicket and India seal the series as they go 2-0 up. A length ball, straight on middle. Kemar Roach shuffles and looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal and up goes the finger. India win by 44 runs.
A slower full ball, on middle. Blocked out.
Shorter, on the body. Kemar Roach looks to evade but gets hit on the arm.
Full, on off. Blocked back to the bowler.
On a length, on off. Roach works it to point.
Slower yorker, outside off. Blocked out.
Kemar Roach is the last batter. Also, Prasidh Krishna is back.

OUT! TAKEN! Ohh yes, and how about a wicket as well. This was the do-or-die over for West Indies! Flatter, quicker, a bit short, outside off. Odean Smith looks to end the over with a maximum but he does not middle it well, he only gets elevation here. It is in the air for a while and goes towards deep mid-wicket. Virat Kohli takes a good catch tumbling back. Odean Smith was stretching the game till the end. He did not have many options and had to go after this ball and perished. Excellent over from Sundar. Just formalities left now.
Commentary.Howout: c Virat Kohli b Washington Sundar

Commentary.Commentary: A single as Alzarri Joseph hits it to deep square leg for a single. Can Washington Sundar finish well?
Quicker again, on the pads. Nudged to square leg.
Sundar keeps it wide from Smith. He toe-ends it to the left of the bowler. Sundar gets across but misfields. Single taken in the end.
Shorter, quicker and on middle, there is turn too. Odean Smith blocks it. Well bowled by Sundar!
Darted on the pads and Alzarri Joseph takes a quick single. Gives the strike back to Odean Smith.
Change in bowling. Washington Sundar is back on. He was gone for 25 in his 4 overs so far.
A full ball, outside off. Smith goes for the slog but it goes over covers. The man at long off moves to his left but it lands safely. Two taken. 11 coming off the over. 48 needed in 36 balls.
Short of length and on off. Smith looks to pull but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
WIDE! A full ball, angling down, it dies on its way. Smith looks to hit but misses.
Good change of pace, on a length, outside off. Smith swings across the line and misses.
FOUR! Powered! A full toss, on middle. Smith smashes it to deep mid-wicket. The man in the deep runs to his left and dives but the ball beats him. Smith is keeping everyone at the edge of the seats!
WIDE! Full again but just wide of the tramline. Left alone. Wide again.
Short of a length, angling down the leg side. Alzarri Joseph pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Full and on middle, pushed to long off for a single.
WIDE! Full and way outside off. Smith leaves it alone. Wided.
Mohammed Siraj is back now. 8.0-1-27-1 are his figures so far.

Yes, he does! This comes with the angle, on middle. Alzarri Joseph stays back and defends. Just three of the over. End of a brilliant spell from Yuzvendra Chahal, 10-0-45-1 are his figures for the day.
Leg spinner, Smith looks to work it on the leg side but gets a leading edge to covers. Just a single. Can Yuzvendra Chahal finish well?
A single as Alzarri Joseph pushes this fuller ball to deep covers.
On the pads, tucked to mid-wicket.
Beautifully bowled! Lands on middle and spins away, beating the outside edge of Alzarri Joseph. Lovely stuff from Chahal.
Full and on the pads. Smith whips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter and on off. Alzarri Joseph gets his bat down to defend. Just 2 from that over. Brilliant from Prasidh Krishna!
Length and on middle, slower one, tucked to square leg for a single.
A full toss and this is pushed to long on for a single.
Short in length, on middle. Alzarri Joseph ducks under it.
This one nips back in, on a length, on off. Alzarri Joseph looks to drive but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Touch fuller, on middle. Alzarri Joseph pushes it back to the bowler.
Prasidh Krishna (7-2-10-3) is back.
A loopy ball, on off. Smith works it to point.
Slower again, Alzarri Joseph guides it to point for a single.
Fuller and on off. Smith goes for the slog but it comes off the toe end to covers. The batters take one.
Tossed up, on off. Blocked out on the front foot.
Full, outside off, spinning away. Smith swings and misses.
A full toss, on middle, pushed back to Chahal who gets low to collect but misfields it and the ball rolls to long on. Smith gets back on strike.
Powerplay 3 time. 67 needed in 60 balls and now 5 fielders can stay outside the ring till the end of the game. Also, Yuzvendra Chahal (8-0-39-1) is back on.
Full and outside off. Odean Smith again goes for the big shot but misses this time.
SIX! WOW! Counterattack from Odean Smith! On a length, on middle. Odean Smith smashes it straight down the ground for a biggie.
SIX! Hold on, Odean Smith is still out there! Short and on middle. He pulls it flat and well over the mid-wicket fence.
JAFFA! On a length, outside off. Odean Smith looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Alzarri Joseph walks out now.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Good catch by Rishabh Pant! Two wickets in two overs and the game is done! Just formalities left. A sharp bouncer, on the body. Akeal Hosein is taken by surprise and decides to fend it away. But it gets too high on him and takes the leading edge. It balloons behind the stumps. Rishabh Pant runs and dives to take it well.
Commentary.Howout: c Rishabh Pant b Shardul Thakur

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter, around off. Hosein runs it to short third man.
Very full, outside off. Driven to mid off.
Odean Smith is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Siraj gets a wicket! An important wicket as this 42-run stand is broken. A cross-seamed short one, outside off. Allen goes for the full-blooded cut but there is a bit of extra bounce again. It takes the outside edge and Rishabh Pant does the rest behind the stumps. 79 needed in 67.
Commentary.Howout: c Rishabh Pant b Mohammed Siraj

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter, around off. Pushed past point for one.

Dropped! Should have been taken! Length ball, on off. Hosein miscues his heave and hits it in the air over mid on. Sundar runs back from that position but he doesn't do too well. He puts in a dive to his left in the end but the ball lands away from him.
A bumper, around leg. Hosein sways away. This is clearly not a wide.
Short and down the leg side. Left alone by Akeal Hosein. It is not given a wide and the batter is not amused. Might have been just down the leg side.
Mohammed Siraj to bowl now.

On a length, on middle. Allen misses the flick and gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW but not given. It rolls towards cover and Hosein looks for a leg bye but is sent back. The fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end. 82 needed from 72.
On a length, on off. Blocked out.
Back of a length, outside off. Akeal Hosein looks to cut it but gets it off the outside edge to third man for one.
Back of a length, outside off. Pushed to cover.
FOUR! Sliced away! Full and outside off. Akeal Hosein carves it past point. Prasidh Krishna runs to his right from sweeper cover and dives. But the ball hits his hands and rolls away to the fence.
Very full, on the pads. Allen flicks it past square leg for one.
Change. Shardul Thakur (7-1-21-1) is brought back.
A single as this full one is pushed to long on. 12 from the over. 88 needed from 13 overs.
Fuller, on off. Clipped to mid on.
SIX! Allen has hammered Hooda! Tossed up, on off. Fabian Allen frees his arms and heaves it over the mid-wicket fence. 89 needed in 80.
Flatter, on middle. Clipped to mid-wicket.
Shorter, on off. Pushed to long off for one.
FOUR! Top shot! Tossed up, outside off. Akeal Hosein drives it nicely through extra cover for a boundary.
Length and on middle. Blocked out.
Length and outside off. Hosein plays it to third man for a single.
Short and on middle. Akeal Hosein steps down and swings across but misses.
Leg bye! That will hurt! Short ball, on middle, it does not bounce much and Allen gets hit on the arm as he looks to duck under it. It rolls away to the leg side and a leg bye is taken.
Banged short, on off. Hosein hops up and plays it past mid-wicket for one.
Shorter, outside off. Left alone.
Now Fabian Allen defends it towards short mid-wicket.
Another dot! Much quicker this, on off, pushed to the left of the bowler.
Hooda keeps bowling in the arc and Allen defends it well.
Tossed up, on off. Blocked out.
Good running! Full and on middle. Allen pushes it straight down and long on comes across to stop it. Two.
Slower, on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Angles a length ball, on off. Blocked out. Just that one boundary from the over.

Just short of first slip! Short ball, on off, the ball shoots off the deck. Akeal Hosein looks to defend but it takes the shoulder of the blade towards first slip where Rohit Sharma dives forward and collects it on a bounce. Prasidh Krishna and Akeal Hosein enjoying the battle against each other.
Nicely driven again by Akeal Hosein but this time straight to the man at mid off.
Short of a length, outside off. Akeal Hosein sways away from it.
FOUR! Beautifully driven! Full and on off. Hosein leans and drives it past the diving mid off fielder for a boundary.
Length and on off. Hosein guides it to point.
Prasidh Krishna (5-2-4-3) is back on. One slip in place.
Now Akeal Hosein hits this well to deep cover and keeps the strike with a single.
Tossed up, outside off. Hosein looks to drive but gets an outside edge to backward point.
Full and on off. Allen smashes it to long on where Suryakumar Yadav catches it on a bounce. One.
Short and outside off, this is hit to deep cover for one more.
Full and on middle. Allen plays it with spin to fine leg for a single.
Tad fuller on off, pushed to long on for a single.
On middle. Fabian Allen reverse-sweeps it but straight to point.
Full and on off. Allen defends it out.
Tossed up, on middle. Worked down to long on for a single.
Spin again but this time Akeal Hosein tucks it to mid-wicket.
Spins back in sharply from way outside off. Akeal Hosein looks to push but gets hit on the pads.
Just a single! Flatter and way outside off. Allen slaps it hard towards deep cover. One.

Flatter and on middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single. Oh, this is called a no ball. Seems like there were three fielders behind the square on the leg side, not confirmed though. Free Hit coming up.
Tossed up, on off. Blocked out.
THREE WIDES! Short and it spins way down the leg side. Allen misses his flick and the keeper fumbles. Two runs taken.

DRINKS! The wicket of Shamarh Brooks is a body blow to the Windies. A big loss at the wrong stage and this will put them under a lot of pressure. But still, if they can get one good stand, then the game will get quite close. Fabian Allen walks out to bat. 121 needed in 115. "Shardul bahar ja raha toh bolke jaa na", yells Rohit Sharma in Hindi! Basically, he is asking Shardul Thakur to inform him if he goes outside the circle. India have really given a Free Hit for having fewer fielders in the ring than required. Would not want to repeat that.

OUT! TAKEN! The first international wicket for Deepak Hooda and it is the wicket of the set batter, Brooks. West Indies are slipping away. Tossed up, on off. Shamarh Brooks looks to heave it but does not middle it at all. It goes high and towards long on. Suryakumar Yadav settles under it and takes it. Brooks walks back after a well-made 44.
Commentary.Howout: c Suryakumar Yadav b Deepak Hooda

Commentary.Commentary: Short and outside off. Akeal Hosein slaps it hard to deep cover for a single.
Full and on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Outside off. Akeal Hosein guides it to backward point.
Length and on off, Brooks slaps it through point for a single.
Change. Deepak Hooda is into the attack for the first time in ODI cricket.
Brooks flicks it off his pads and gets a single.
Tossed up, around middle and leg. Brooks gets hit on the pads while looking to block. An appeal for LBW but turned down. Likely sliding down leg.
Well bowled. A flipper, on middle. Brooks backs away to cut but the ball goes straight after landing. Brooks gets it past short third man for a couple though.
Lands on off and turns back in. Akeal Hosein works it with the turn towards fine leg for one.
Shorter, on the body. Brooks looks to flick but gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls away and they cross ends. Given as runs, so there might have been an inside edge there.
Tossed up, on off. Brooks is once again beaten as the ball turns past his attempted defence.
Change of ends for Yuzvendra Chahal.
Yet another single as Brooks flicks it.
Tossed up, around leg. Brooks misses the sweep. It might have flicked his pad.
FOUR! Solid shot! Short and on the body. Brooks rocks back and pulls it to the square leg fence.
Shorter, on the body. Tucked to mid-wicket.
Flatter, on the body. Brooks flicks it past square leg and gets a couple.
Shorter and outside off. Hosein clips it towards long on for one.
Short and outside off. Akeal Hosein rises with the bounce and runs it to third man for one.
Very full, on off. Pushed to mid off.
Length ball, angling across off. Hosein gets no bat on it while looking to block.
On a length, on the pads. Brooks misses the flick and gets hit on the pads. The ball runs past short fine leg for one.
Length ball, on off. Played to covers.
FOUR! Edged and a boundary! Length ball, outside off. Brooks goes for the drive but gets the outside edge. It runs to the third man fence. 100 up for West Indies!
Mohammed Siraj to continue.
A single as Brooks flicks this short ball past square leg for one.
Shorter, on off. Worked to square leg.
Fuller, on off. Pushed to long off for one.
Tossed up, on the pads. Brooks sweeps it to fine leg for one.
Shorter, on off. Brooks works it to mid-wicket.
Loopy ball, on off. Driven to long off for one.
Catch is the call but it falls well short! Short in length, on middle. Akeal Hosein miscues his pull towards deep square leg. One.
Short in length, on off. Hosein hops and defends it to point.
Touch fuller, on middle. Defended.
Beaten! Length and slanting just outside off. Akeal Hosein has a poke at it but misses.
Length and on middle. Blocked out.
Length ball, outside off. Hosein taps it to point.
Change. Mohammed Siraj is back on.
Flatter, spinning in, on middle, Brooks pushes to covers.
Now Akeal Hosein punches off the back foot towards deep cover for a single.
Flatter and on middle, drilled down to wide long on for a single.
Tossed up, outside off, pushed back to Sundar.
Short and on middle. Brooks wrists it to square leg.
SIX! Makes full use of it! Tossed up, on off. Shamarh Brooks thumps it over cow corner for a maximum.
Flatter and on off. Brooks steers it to the third man region for a brace. A no ball given as there was an extra man standing outside the circle. Free Hit coming up.
Short ball, outside off. Hosein thinks to ramp it away but leaves it alone in the end. 158 needed in 156 balls.
Thakur drags his length ball, on off. Hosein gets on his toes as he defends this.
Length ball, outside off. Brooks plays it square on the off side for a run.
Length and on off. Hosein hops and punches it to the left of mid off and takes a quick single.
On off, on a length. Blocked out.
Length ball, angling outside off. Hosein looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
A flighted ball, way outside off. Asking Shamarh Brooks to drive and he misses his attempted shot.
On middle, Brooks works it to mid-wicket.
Darted on the pads, this is flicked to deep square leg for a single.
On off, pushed through covers for a single.
Sharp turn for Chahal. Around off, lands and spins away. Brooks looks to defend but misses.
A loopy ball, on middle. Brooks prods to defend but manages to get an inside edge and it almost rolls back onto the stumps.
Akeal Hosein makes his way to the middle.

OUT! TAKEN! Hook, line and sinker! Another one bites the dust! Rohit Sharma keeps rotating his bowlers and they are all getting the reward. A short ball, on middle. Jason Holder instinctively goes for the pull. But the ball gets high on him and takes the top edge. The ball flies high in the air to deep mid-wicket and Deepak Hooda takes it well. Good placement by Rohit Sharma and good execution by Shardul Thakur.
Commentary.Howout: c Deepak Hooda b Shardul Thakur

Commentary.Commentary: Outside off. Left alone.
Length ball, way outside off. Holder shuffles a bit across and leaves it alone. Wide not given and Holder is not happy with it.
Length and on off, pushed to deep cover for one.
Length ball, outside off. Holder hits it aerially over point. The sweeper cover comes across and cuts it off. Just a single.
Length ball, way outside off. Holder leaves it alone.
After that wicket-taking over, Prasidh Krishna is taken off. Shardul Thakur (5-1-19-0) replaces him.
Flatter, slower and keeps low as well. Brooks plays it late to backward point.
A single as this is hit to deep point.
This one just holds in the surface. Holder looks to push but mistimes it back to Chahal.
Full, flighted on middle. Holder defends on the front foot.
On the pads, clipped to short fine leg for a single.
SIX! Brooks hits to the longer side and all the way for a six! Full and on off. Shamarh Brooks slog-sweeps it over cow corner for a biggie. It was a googly but Brooks read it right away.
Change. Yuzvendra Chahal (4-0-20-1) is back on. Just the single over for Washington Sundar then.
Banged in short, on off. Holder is tall enough to block it without fuss.
Length ball, outside off. Some away shape on that and left alone.
Jason Holder is the new man in. Two slips are in place for him.

OUT! TAKEN! Straight to first slip! Back of a length, this lands on off and angles away again. Pooran is forced to play at it. He opens the face of the bat a bit. It goes nicely to first slip and Rohit Sharma gets a bit low to gather it! West Indies lose the skipper and they lose their fourth wicket. This means India will now have a go at their weak middle order.
Commentary.Howout: c Rohit Sharma b Prasidh Krishna

Commentary.Commentary: This time, Pooran blocks this length ball to short cover.
Jaffa! Length ball, lands on off and angles away from the left-hander. Pooran looks to block it from the crease but is beaten.
Short of a length, around off. Brooks hops and glides it to third man for one.
A bit of loop there, on middle. Pooran blocks it off the front foot.
Shorter, outside off. Pooran plays it to short cover.
Loopy ball, on the pads. Worked to mid-wicket.
Sundar bowls it shorter and quicker, middle. Pooran goes for the pull but gets the inside edge on the pads.
Fuller, outside off. Brooks works it to long on for one.
Tossed up, outside off. Pooran drills it to long off for a single.
Change. Washington Sundar to bowl now.
Pooran nails the pull shot along the ground. But it goes straight towards deep mid-wicket. Just a single then.
Back of a length, outside off. Punched to deep cover for one.

Good keeping! A sharp short one by Thakur. Brooks misses the pull and Pant throws himself to his left to gather it with one hand. The ball moved quite a bit after passing the batter but Pant does well.
Back of a length, outside off. Pushed to backward point. Three dots in a row.
Didn't carry! Short and outside off. Brooks cracks it towards backward point. It is dipping and Suryakumar Yadav gets forward to gather it. But it drops just sort of his hands.
Short of a length, outside off. Brooks pushes it to point.
Flatter and on off. Pooran defends it towards cover where the fielder puts a dive to his right and stops it.
Tossed up, on off, pushed to long off for a run.
Loopy ball, on off. Worked back to the bowler. Chahal fails to gather it cleanly and it goes to long on. Single.
That six was a huge one and the ball cannot be retrieved from the stands. Out comes the box and the umpires change the ball

SIX! Pooran gets off the mark in style! Short and on middle. Pooran rocks back and pulls it way over the mid-wicket fence. Rohit Sharma is not at all happy. He is not happy that Chahal switched to 'round the wicket to bowl the Free Hit.
Tossed up, on off. Pooran gets forward to block. They check for the front-foot no ball and Chahal is guilty! Pooran has a Free Hit to get off the mark!

DRINKS! India on the front foot. They have done exceptionally well to keep the pressure. West Indies need a big partnership and will hope the skipper, Nicholas Pooran, plays a match-winning knock here as he comes out to the middle.

OUT! TAKEN! Gone this time! Chahal gets a wicket and the batter who was looking good for West Indies is walking back! This is tossed up, a bit wide outside off. Shai Hope looks to get another boundary off Chahal and drags it from outside off. He slog-sweeps it but hits it very flat. The ball goes to the right of long on. Suryakumar Yadav moves to his right and takes the catch. 186 needed in 202 balls, the required rate is over 5.5 now.
Commentary.Howout: c Suryakumar Yadav b Yuzvendra Chahal

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, on off. Hope gets forward to block it with ease.
Just a single now. Shorter and on the body. Hope shuffles a bit and then manages to flick it to fine leg for a single. 2 from that over.
On a length, on off. Hope ends up tapping it towards point.
Quite full, outside off. Hope drives it to mid off. Dot again.
Back of a length, outside off. A bit of away shape and Hope punches it to cover.
This is on a length and wide outside off. Hope leaves this one.
Thakur bowls it full and on the pads. Brooks flicks it through mid-wicket and gets a single.
Change. Shardul Thakur is back into the attack.
Flatter and on off, this is hit to deep point for a single.
BEATEN AGAIN! Yuzvendra Chahal continues to bowl on middle, the ball lands again and spins away. Brooks lunges to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
A single as this is eased down to long on.
FOUR! Good shot! Tossed up, on middle. Hope whips it away and gets hit in the air. But it goes wide of long on and runs to the fence. Brilliant strokeplay.
Brilliant from Chahal! This one lands on middle and spins away. It beats the outside edge of Hope's attempted defence and also whizzes past the off pole.
On middle, fuller, Hope prods and defends.
Lovely bowling from Prasidh Krishna! Short of a length, outside off. Brooks looks to push but misses it.
A pacy short ball, on middle. Brooks lets it through to the keeper.
Length ball, outside off. Hope gets a thick outside edge on his attempted drive. The ball goes to third man for a single.
Short ball, extra pace as well, outside off. Hope slashes and misses.
On middle. Blocked out.
Good fielding! Length ball, outside off. Hope guides it to the left of point where Suryakumar Yadav puts a dive to stop it.
Sharp turn there! It lands on off and spins away. Brooks gets on the front foot and looks to defend but gets beaten.
This is drilled down to long on for a single.
Flatter and on middle, pushed to mid on.
Goes inside out now does Hope, over covers and takes a couple of runs.
Tossed up, on middle. Hope gets on the front foot to defend.
Fuller, slower in the air, on off. Hope prods and blocks it out.
Length and way outside off. Left alone.
On a length, on off. Brooks, on the back foot, works it to point.
Length ball, way outside off. Shamarh Brooks looks to drive but fails to get ay bat on it.
Hint of away shape there, on a length, on off. Brooks defends it out.
On a length, on off. Brooks blocks it out.
Short of a length, on off. Brooks gets on his toes and punches it to covers.
Shorter and on off, this is hit to cover.
Very full, on middle, Brooks wrists it to deep square leg for a single.
Fuller and on off, pushed to covers.
Flatter and on off. Blocked out.
Tossed up again, Brooks looks to drive but it goes off the inner half back to the bowler.
Tossed up, on middle. Hope flicks it to square leg for a single.
End of Powerplay 1! 4 fielders can stay outside the ring till the 40th over now. Also, Yuzvendra Chahal is brought on now.
A solid defensive push to end the over. That ends Powerplay 1 and West Indies are 38 for 2. India were 37 for 1. That extra wicket could cost the Windies.
Play and a miss! Short and outside off. Brooks looks to punch it away but the ball shapes away and goes past the bat.
Short of a length, around off. Blocked by Brooks again.
On a length, on off. Blocked out.
Play and a miss! Full and outside off. Brooks misses the drive.
Shamarh Brooks walks out.
Review time! India take a review for caught behind!

OUT! TAKEN! The review is a good one! There was a big noise there! India reviewed this for caught behind. The bat did hit the pad but the question was whether the ball brushed the bat too. UltraEdge confirms that it did! India get another wicket and Bravo goes back for a timid score. This was on a length, angling across off. Bravo looked to block but failed. There was a noise and a big appeal for caught behind. But the umpire was unmoved. Rohit Sharma though decided to review it after thinking a bit. The UltraEdge rolls in and it showed a spike as the ball went past the bat!
Commentary.Howout: c Rishabh Pant b Prasidh Krishna

Commentary.Commentary: Sharp bouncer! On the body and Hope goes for the pull. The ball zips past him. Pant hops up to gather it.
Banged short, down the leg side. Hope ducks and leaves it. He leaves it bat hanging a bit too high but the ball goes over it.
Very full, on off. Played to mid on.
On a length, around off. Hope taps it to point.
FOUR! No need to run for that! That has been gloriously driven! Overpitched and outside off. Hope drives it through extra cover and gets a boundary.
Back of a length, on the body. Worked to the leg side.
Banged in short, around off. Bravo fails to sway away and gets hit on the shoulder.
Length ball, on middle. Hope looks to block but there is extra bit of bounce and he gets hit on the thigh pad.
Shorter, on the body. Pulled to mid on for one. Bravo is off the mark.
Darren Bravo walks out at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Extra bounce does the trick! Short and wide outside off. Brandon King gets on his toes and goes for it but gets the outside edge. Pant takes an easy catch behind the stumps. West Indies lose their first. There was a bit of extra bounce there and that proved to be the undoing for King.
Commentary.Howout: c Rishabh Pant b Prasidh Krishna

Commentary.Commentary: Length ball, on middle. King gets his bat low enough to block.
Back of a length, on the body. Hope flicks it away for one.
Change. Prasidh Krishna is into the attack.
Ouch! Short and on the body. Hope misses the pull and gets rapped on the helmet. It rolls to third man and they take a leg bye. A mandatory concussion protocol to follow.

Good appeal for LBW! Length ball, lands on off and comes back in. King is beaten and gets hit on the pads. There is a big appeal but turned. Might be heading down leg. A leg bye as the batters crossed over.
Full and on off. Hope drives it straight down the ground for a single.
Through the gate! This lands outside off and comes back in. Hope is beaten and the ball goes through the gate. Pant moves to his left to gather it.
Very full, on off. Hope blocks it to mid on.
On a length, outside off. Hope taps it to cover.
Very full, on off. Blocked out.
FOUR! Shot! This is much better! King cuts it well and gets it through covers for a boundary.
FOUR! Edged and away! Short and wide outside off. King goes for the cut and gets the outside edge. The ball runs over first slip and it runs to the fence.
Length ball, on off. Hope flicks it to fine leg for one.
Short and outside off. Hope misses the cut.
FOUR! Down the leg side! Full and down the leg side. Hope gets it past Pant's dive to his left. It runs to the fence.

SIX! Straight down the ground! A positive start from West Indies! Putting the loose balls away! On a length, on middle. King lofts it straight over the bowler's head and it goes all the way for a biggie.
On a length, on middle. King hops and blocks it.
Outside off. Left alone.
A length ball, outside off. King punches off the back foot, beats the diving cover-point fielder and deep backward point comes across to stop it. Two.
On middle, pushed to mid on.
Length and outside off, punched to covers.
Some late movement there and Rishabh Pant did well to collect it. Short ball, on off. Shai Hope misses his pull. The ball swings late and Pant adjusts well.
A length ball, shaping touch away, outside off. Hope responds with another defense.
Length ball, outside off. Hope hits it to point.
Length ball, on off. Hope whips it but straight to mid-wicket. Good shot but for no run.
Around off, on a length. King carves it to third man for a single.
Length and outside off. Hope pushes it to the left of mid off and a single is taken.
Consecutive maidens! Short of a length, on middle. King hops and keeps it out.
Full and on middle. King's bat turns as he looks to push and the ball rolls to mid on.
Good carry there! Short ball, on off. Brandon King sits under it. Pant takes it near his head.
This one comes with the angle but King defends it solidly.
Length ball, angling away, on off. Blocked out.
Good stop! On a length, on middle. King punches it straight down but Siraj gets his right hand to it and stops it.
Maiden to start from Shardul Thakur! Length ball, outside off. Shai Hope shoulders arms to it.
Good shape from Thakur, outside off. Hope gets his bat down and blocks it.
Length and targeting the stumps. Hope gets behind the line of the ball and defends it out.
On a length, outside off. Hope blocks it out.
Length ball, hint of away shape, outside off. Hope knocks it to covers.
Full ball, on middle. Hope defends it on the leg side.
Who will use the other new ball? It is Shardul Thakur.
Good running! Length and on off. Hope looks to push but gets an inside edge, in the gap through mid-wicket and they take three runs.
On middle, on a length. Hope blocks it out.
Slants a full ball, on the pads, flicked to square leg.
Fuller, swinging in, on middle. Hope pushes it to mid on.
Length ball, on off. King looks to defend but gets a thick outside edge to third man for a single. He is off the mark as well.
A full ball, shaping away outside off, pushed to covers for a single. Shai Hope and West Indies are underway.
